skill.name: parallel-task
skill.description: Orchestrates development tasks from Markdown plans across dependency-aware subagent waves, with validation, local commits, and plan-log updates.
skill.summary: Execute structured development plans with parallel subagents, dependency ordering, test evidence, local commits, and progress logs.
skill.author: am-will

content.value_statement: Large development plans are slow and difficult to coordinate across dependent tasks. This skill schedules subagents in dependency-aware waves, validates their work, commits changes, and updates plan logs.
actual_capabilities: Parses Markdown plans into task IDs, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and validation steps.
Filters selected tasks while including their required dependencies.
Launches unblocked tasks in parallel and advances work through dependency waves.
Requires RED-to-GREEN test evidence or an explicit alternative verification method.
Directs each subagent to commit only task files and update plan logs.
Reviews completion evidence and retries or escalates unsuccessful tasks.
limitations: Requires a structured Markdown plan with task sections and dependency lists.
Depends on available subagent orchestration, repository access, and local development tools.
Creates local commits but explicitly does not push them.

use_cases.title: Dependency-Aware Feature Delivery
use_cases.description: Run a multi-task feature plan while preserving prerequisite order and parallelizing independent implementation work.

use_cases.title: Parallel Refactor Coordination
use_cases.description: Coordinate separate refactor tasks, local commits, validation evidence, and plan updates across several subagents.

use_cases.title: Auditable TDD Execution
use_cases.description: Require failing tests, passing results, or documented alternative checks before each planned task is completed.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Complete Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: /parallel-task [plan-file]. Execute every task, honor dependencies, validate each result, commit task changes locally, and update the plan log.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: execute one complete, structured development plan.

prompt_templates.title: Run Selected Tasks
prompt_templates.prompt: /parallel-task [plan-file] [task-ids]. Run only these tasks and required dependencies, then report completed, blocked, and deferred work.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: complete a selected part of a larger plan.

prompt_templates.title: Enforce TDD Evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: /parallel-task [plan-file]. Require failing tests before implementation, passing tests afterward, and documented alternative checks for tasks that cannot use TDD.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: apply consistent verification requirements across all tasks.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate a Complex Delivery
prompt_templates.prompt: /parallel-task [plan-file] [task-ids]. Build dependency waves, run unblocked work in parallel, retry incomplete tasks, and summarize commits, evidence, and blockers.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate selected tasks with dependencies and recovery steps.

output: Wave 1 completed: T1 added failing authentication tests, implemented the change, and recorded passing results.
Wave 2 completed: T2 and T3 ran in parallel after T1.
All task commits remain local, and the plan log contains completion evidence.

output_examples.input: Run tasks T3 and T7 from the user profile plan, including prerequisites.
output_examples.output: T3 completed with RED-to-GREEN evidence and a local commit. T7 remains blocked because its required dependency is incomplete.

output_examples.input: Run a documentation task that cannot use automated tests.
output_examples.output: The task recorded reason_not_testable and defined a static documentation check. The check passed, the task was committed locally, and the plan log was updated.

best_practices: Use task IDs and explicit depends_on lists so the skill can build accurate execution waves.
Give every task concrete acceptance criteria and exact validation steps.
Review local commits and plan logs before integrating or pushing changes.
anti_patterns: Do not invoke the skill without a structured plan file.
Do not run tightly coupled tasks in parallel when dependencies are missing.
Do not treat a task as complete without test evidence or a documented alternative check.

faq.question: What plan format does this skill expect?
faq.answer: It expects Markdown task sections with task IDs, dependency lists, descriptions, acceptance criteria, and validation steps.

faq.question: Can I execute only selected tasks?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide task IDs, and the skill includes their required dependencies.

faq.question: Does the skill run every task in parallel?
faq.answer: No. It runs only unblocked tasks in parallel and waits for dependencies before starting later waves.

faq.question: Does every task require automated tests?
faq.answer: The skill defaults to TDD. Unsuitable tasks need a reason and an exact alternative verification method.

faq.question: Does the skill push commits to a remote repository?
faq.answer: No. It creates local task commits and explicitly prohibits pushing them.

faq.question: What happens when a task fails?
faq.answer: The skill requests a retry or escalation, records the blocker, and delays dependent work.
